title: Repair the canonical Saw feasibility path so it evaluates the submitted Saw process facts instead of silently scoring against hardcoded defaults
intent: Fix the manufacturing-authority defect that made the canonical Saw feasibility path return a constant catastrophic RED/49.4 for every job. compute_saw_feasibility supplied Saw facts that RmosContext did not declare (pydantic v2 extra='ignore' discarded them); SawEngine then substituted conversion defaults (blade_diameter 254mm, max_rpm 5000, feed 3000, machine_power 3kW) and Rosette-geometry aliases (outer_diameter->cut_length, ring_count->repeat_count, pattern_type->cut_type), so the calculators scored a fabricated cut. This increment carries every calculator-consumed fact explicitly: RmosContext gains the Saw process fields, a new SawScorerDesignSpec carries the Saw design facts, the canonical SawEngine converters map 1:1 with NO fallback constants / NO tool_id parsing / NO Rosette aliases (the legacy default-driven converters are isolated for the ungoverned toolpath route only), and compute_saw_feasibility guards every required fact (missing -> UNKNOWN, invalid/out-of-range -> ERROR). Transport and adaptation only: no calculator formula, weight, threshold, or risk boundary changes; neither Saw route is contained; SawLabService.check_feasibility and the compare route are untouched; the manufacturing-output inventory stays at 13 LIVE_UNGOVERNED.

diff_articulation.what_changed: RmosContext gained the explicit Saw process fields the calculators consume (blade_diameter_mm, blade_kerf_mm, blade_thickness_mm, arbor_size_mm, stock_thickness_mm, machine_power_kw, blade_youngs_modulus_gpa, use_dust_collection; rpm/feed_rate_mm_min/tooth_count were already present), with bounds mirroring saw_lab.models.SawContext; the undeclared machine_id field is removed in favour of the pre-existing machine_profile_id. A new SawScorerDesignSpec (router) carries the explicit Saw design facts (cut_length_mm, cut_type, miter_angle_deg, bevel_angle_deg, dado_width_mm, dado_depth_mm, repeat_count) with bounds mirroring SawDesign; it is distinct from the rosette-shaped ScorerDesignSpec and carries no Rosette geometry. _score_via_scorer now additively forwards all Saw context fields and machine_profile_id (None for non-saw modes, which do not read them). saw_engine gained strict canonical converters _convert_to_saw_context(ctx) and _convert_to_saw_design(design) that map 1:1 with NO fallback constants, NO tool_id parsing, and NO Rosette aliases; the prior default/alias converters are retained verbatim as _convert_to_saw_context_legacy/_convert_to_saw_design_legacy used ONLY by the ungoverned toolpath-generation route (SawEngine.generate_toolpaths / plan_saw_toolpaths), whose behaviour is unchanged. compute_saw_feasibility now validates the full calculator-consumed contract (12 context facts + the consumed design facts), distinguishing missing (-> UNKNOWN) from invalid (non-numeric, boolean-for-number, empty string, non-integral rpm/tooth_count/repeat_count -> ERROR), converts spindle_power_watts -> machine_power_kw exactly once, and constructs SawScorerDesignSpec (out-of-range -> ValidationError -> ERROR). Integer facts are not truncated with int(): rpm and repeat_count are passed through, so 3450.7 and 2.9 fail closed instead of scoring as 3450 and 2. The superseded test_saw_evaluator_plumbing.py is removed and replaced by test_saw_authority_context.py; TC-09 and TC-20 fixtures are upgraded to the complete, truthful Saw request.
diff_articulation.why: A feasibility lane that cannot see its own process facts is not evaluating the cut it was asked about; it produced a constant RED/49.4 regardless of RPM/feed/power/blade. Order 006 authorized repairing this transport/adaptation defect, carrying every calculator-consumed fact explicitly and failing closed when a safety-relevant fact is absent or invalid.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The earlier #420 draft only declared a subset of the fields, still guarded 6 request keys, and left SawEngine's default-driven converters and Rosette-geometry aliases in the canonical path. Merged #420 carried the explicit contract; the same branch then closed the remaining int() truncation of non-integral rpm and repeat_count. This manifest is the completed 006 contract: the full calculator contract is guarded, the canonical converters are strict (default-free, alias-free, no tool_id parsing), the Saw design flows through an explicit SawScorerDesignSpec, missing facts are blocking UNKNOWN with a null score, invalid facts are blocking ERROR, and structural AST tests pin the absence of fallback constants / Rosette aliases.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No calculator formula, threshold, weight, material coefficient, or favourable default was changed. Neither Saw route is contained. SawLabService.check_feasibility, the saw_compare route, and all G-code/geometry/generators are untouched. The manufacturing-output inventory is not regenerated and remains at 13 LIVE_UNGOVERNED. Rosette/adaptive/profiling feasibility paths are unaffected (the new RmosContext fields are optional and unread by those modes; _score_via_scorer additions are None for them). The legacy toolpath-generation conversion is preserved verbatim behind *_legacy helpers.
diff_articulation.representative_cases: PERMITTED (GREEN/YELLOW) WITNESS IS A DOCUMENTED STOP, NOT FABRICATED: with the frozen calculators the deflection and heat calculators flag RED for every in-range ordinary setup (an independent 2,880-combination sweep found a best aggregate of 69.8, still RED; consistent with PR #420's 9,600-point finding). The RED is driven by the calculator bundle's specific_cutting_energy default of 30 J/mm^3 cascading into cutting-force overload, excessive deflection, and critical heat - a formula/units defect explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this transport repair (006 forbids changing formulas/thresholds and forbids tuning physics to satisfy SAC-025). test_sac025_no_honest_permit_is_a_documented_stop pins the limitation. BLOCKED witnesses pass with the real evaluator: a deliberately unsafe fixture (18000 mm/min feed on 100mm stock, 0.5 kW, 9000 rpm) -> RED; each omitted required fact -> UNKNOWN naming the fact; invalid (negative/over-range/boolean) -> ERROR; the old minimal {tool_id, material_id} and Rosette-geometry-only requests -> UNKNOWN; distinct inputs no longer collapse to 49.4 (scores span ~27-70).

proofs: Clean Cloud Agent re-validation 2026-10-02 on cursor/cf2-saw-evaluator-plumbing-006. Merge-base equals origin/main e06b3075 (merged PR #420).
